construction: Sealed source-content-first synthetic questions and partial relevance judgements, authored without retrieval rankings. Release only after runtime candidate revision/source digest freeze.

relevant.rationale: The DALI section explains queue buffering, executor statistics and execution-mode gates together.

cases.cue: Can a serving simulator certify latency SLOs near queue capacity?

relevant.rationale: The calibration procedure requires dynamic queue-delay validation at the intended load and rejects near-capacity predictive certification without evidence.
The preemption procedure counts suspended state and requires progress under pressure, rather than treating priority alone as a guarantee.
The ACLGraph procedure states the caller's stable-buffer responsibility and the limited coverage of address assertions.

cases.cue: How is moving a request between replicas different from changing its sequence parallel group?

relevant.rationale: This procedure directly separates Llumnix replica migration from LoongServe sequence-parallel group changes and their state costs.
The headroom procedure distinguishes analytical, attainable component and end-to-end ceilings and supplies a bounded roofline arithmetic helper.

cases.no_answer_rationale: Constructed nonce terms with no intended library answer; any returned candidates remain visible as negative-query behavior.
